title: Information-Gain Calibrated On-Policy Distillation for Deep Search Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.20664v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) has recently emerged as a promising approach for transferring the capabilities of large agents to compact students. In deep search, where agents iteratively retrieve external evidence, a teacher's preference among plausible queries before retrieval may not predict which queries will return useful evidence. Standard OPD nevertheless supervises each student query from the preceding context alone, inducing a failure mode we term \textbf{\textit{evidence-blind supervision (EBS)}}. To understand this, we regroup the OPD objective by interaction turns and reveal two implicit priors: a \textit{budget prior} that allocates supervision by token volume, and a \textit{direction prior} that favors tokens preferred by the teacher, neither of which accounts for the evidence returned by the current query. Our empirical analysis shows that both priors contribute to EBS in practice: the first search turn accounts for 51.1\% o

translated_title: 面向深度搜索智能体的信息增益校准在线策略蒸馏
translated_abstract: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）近来已成为一种将大型智能体能力迁移到紧凑学生模型的有前景的方法。在深度搜索场景中，智能体需要迭代地检索外部证据，而教师在检索之前对各候选查询的偏好可能无法预测哪些查询会返回有用的证据。然而，标准的OPD仅依据先前的上下文来监督学生的每个查询，由此引发了一种我们称为“证据盲监督（EBS）”的失败模式。为了理解这一问题，我们按交互轮次对OPD目标进行重新分组，并揭示了两个隐式先验：一个是按词元数量分配监督权重的“预算先验”，另一个是偏好教师所偏好词元的“方向先验”，而这两者都没有考虑当前查询所返回的证据。我们的实证分析表明，这两个先验在实践中都助长了EBS：第一轮搜索占据了51.1%的[摘要在此处截断]
tldr: 该论文揭示了标准在线策略蒸馏中因忽视检索证据而产生的“证据盲监督”失败模式及其背后的预算先验与方向先验两种隐式偏差，并提出用信息增益来校准监督信号，从而改进深度搜索智能体的蒸馏训练。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies an "evidence-blind supervision" failure mode in standard on-policy distillation—caused by implicit budget and direction priors that ignore retrieved evidence—and proposes information-gain calibrated supervision to improve deep search agent distillation.
